head_commit.message:
Merge qualified v0.5.0-alpha.3 (#1494)

Prepare v0.5.0-alpha.3 values and numeric protocols

method.confirmation: A candidate triggers three further paired samples. Warning requires both batches to be candidates and each batch's base/head sample ranges not to overlap; otherwise unconfirmed.
method.ordering: CPython, base and head interleaved with rotating order; warm compiled caches; correctness comparisons precede sampling and occur during sampling.
method.graph_copy_loop_clock: CPU process time; other loop measurements use wall time.
method.build_metrics: One metric per source, shown on its first workload.

evidence_scope.review_method: GitHub connector read-only metadata, decoded completed job log, and exact-commit runner/workflow source.
limitations: Only the printed rounded medians/statuses and the successful execution were reviewed; raw sample arrays, recorded CPU/load values and ranges remain in the artifact.
This is the maintained advisory smoke workload set, not a universal no-regression or overall speedup claim.
The performance compiler builds do not substitute for bootstrap fixed-point qualification or any other release gate.

source_files.content:
name: Performance smoke

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 8 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      base:
        description: Baseline commit or ref (default is the pinned performance reference)
        required: false

concurrency:
  group: perf-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      PYSTACHY_LLVM: /usr/lib/llvm-18/bin
      # Deliberately fixed: changing this starts a new cumulative comparison series.
      PERF_REFERENCE: 80840d264b2d4e76c21a8deec6db90ce6e3c5b22
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          path: head
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Select baseline
        working-directory: head
        env:
          BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before || inputs.base }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$BASE" ]; then BASE=$PERF_REFERENCE; fi
          git check-ref-format --allow-onelevel "$BASE"
          echo "PERF_BASE=$BASE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.PERF_BASE }}
          path: base
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0  # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version-file: head/.python-version
      - run: tools/setup.sh --minimal
        working-directory: head
      - name: Paired performance smoke
        working-directory: head
        run: python3 tools/perf_smoke.py --base ../base --json ../perf-smoke.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: ${{ (github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && 'perf-reference' || 'perf-smoke' }}
          path: perf-smoke.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: ${{ (github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && 90 || 30 }}
